facts.statement: The machine phase processes machine parts from left to right.
facts.sourceSentence: At the start of the machine phase, go from left to right down the row of machine parts in play, cycling each card's track and resolving its abilities as follows:

facts.statement: Yellow die moves one space down the cycle track during processing.
facts.sourceSentence: Move a machine part card's yellow die 1 space down its cycle track.

facts.statement: When a die lands on an icon, the icon's corresponding ability triggers immediately.
facts.sourceSentence: If that dice lands on an icon, immediately trigger that icon's corresponding ability.

facts.statement: Dead spaces are darkened squares on the cycle track.
facts.sourceSentence: If moving the die places it on a dead space (darkened square), then move that die back to the starting position on the track.

facts.statement: When a die lands on a dead space, it returns to the starting position on the track.
facts.sourceSentence: If moving the die places it on a dead space (darkened square), then move that die back to the starting position on the track.

facts.statement: After cycling one card, proceed to the next card to the right.
facts.sourceSentence: Proceed to the next machine part card in the line (moving right) and repeat the card cycling process until all part cards have increased their cycle track by 1 and resolved any abilities/effects that are triggered.

facts.statement: Card cycling continues until all cards in play have cycled once.
facts.sourceSentence: Proceed to the next machine part card in the line (moving right) and repeat the card cycling process until all part cards have increased their cycle track by 1 and resolved any abilities/effects that are triggered.

facts.statement: After all cards have cycled, the entire machine part row shifts one space to the right.
facts.sourceSentence: Now, carefully slide the entire machine part card row one space to the right.

facts.statement: A new machine part card is drawn and placed in the space opened by the row shift.
facts.sourceSentence: Draw a new machine part card and slot it into the available space.

facts.statement: New machine part cards receive a yellow HP die.
facts.sourceSentence: Add a yellow HP die to the first cycle tracking space on the new card, setting the die face to the correct starting HP value for that card.

facts.statement: The HP die on a new card is placed on the first cycle tracking space.
facts.sourceSentence: Add a yellow HP die to the first cycle tracking space on the new card, setting the die face to the correct starting HP value for that card.

facts.statement: The HP die is set to the new card's starting HP value.
facts.sourceSentence: Add a yellow HP die to the first cycle tracking space on the new card, setting the die face to the correct starting HP value for that card.

facts.statement: A maximum of 10 machine parts can be in play at any time.
facts.sourceSentence: There can never be more than 10 machine parts in play at any given time.

facts.statement: If 10 machine parts are already in play, no new card is drawn.
facts.sourceSentence: If 10 cards are active on the line, then skip drawing a new card and proceed with play.

facts.statement: After all cards have cycled and a new card is added, gather all spent dice.
facts.sourceSentence: When all machine part cards have cycled and a new card is added to the line, gather all of your spent dice (including any new dice you may have obtained by defeating machine parts) and return to Phase I.

facts.statement: Defeated machine parts provide new dice to collect.
facts.sourceSentence: When all machine part cards have cycled and a new card is added to the line, gather all of your spent dice (including any new dice you may have obtained by defeating machine parts) and return to Phase I.

facts.statement: After gathering dice, return to Phase I.
facts.sourceSentence: When all machine part cards have cycled and a new card is added to the line, gather all of your spent dice (including any new dice you may have obtained by defeating machine parts) and return to Phase I.

facts.statement: Shields can prevent some or all of the damage dealt by abilities.
facts.sourceSentence: If they don't have enough shields to prevent some or all of that damage.

facts.statement: Unblocked damage reduces player HP directly.
facts.sourceSentence: Unblocked damage carries over and reduces HP directly.
